title: Narrow a task body before closing it when scope is split
body: Outcome: a slice that delivers less than its task body cannot close that task as done with the original acceptance. Evidence: PR #171 review attempt 1 (standards BLOCKING, .krn/runs/review-series/afdaedfc.../records/1.json) failed because t-zr25epj was closed while its body still required a second Jenkins executor that was split into t-vgd1bp3; it cost one review attempt. Acceptance: krn-lead step 6 says to narrow the task body (krn task edit before close) when scope is split, and a rule test checks that sentence; or krn task close refuses --as done when --note names another open task id without a body edit.
